deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications for Computer Science are due January 8, 2027.
deadline.quote: Computer Science * Economics * English History Philosophy Theology January 8, 2027

gre_general.value: The Computer Science PhD requires the GRE General test.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are required for the PhD in Computer Science program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The Computer Science PhD sets its own TOEFL iBT minimum of 4.5 (new scale) for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026.
toefl_min.quote: Taken on or after January 21, 2026 - Minimum score: 4.5

ielts_min.value: The Computer Science PhD sets its own IELTS minimum of 6.5 band.

supervisor.value: The Computer Science PhD pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Accepted Computer Science PhD students receive guaranteed support for five years.
funding.quote: With guaranteed support for five years, accepted students will have the opportunity

entry_route.value: Applicants need a four-year bachelor's degree; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: applicants must hold a four-year bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in the United States

also.quote: bachelor's degree, and if applicable, master's degree

notes: The program runs 60 months with classes from August 2027 and is a registered STEM program.
name: Ph.D. in Computer Science
